sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page collects police and court records related to Ben Schneider (Reckless Ben), including American Fork incidents from March 8–11, 2026.
Use Police Records to find the documents and officer profiles for each incident. The Timeline explains the documented roles of the officers and links to the supporting records.

sections.title: Police Records
descriptions: Police records associated with Ben Schneider are organized below by law-enforcement agency and incident.

sections.title: Timeline
descriptions: This timeline covers the American Fork incidents and later evidence collection. Police reports describe the officers’ accounts; differing explanations from participants are identified where relevant.

sections.title: Criminal Cases
descriptions: Court records associated with Ben Schneider are organized below by jurisdiction and case number.

sections.title: Media Coverage
descriptions: News coverage of the LEGO dispute and Ben Schneider’s encounters with police, listed newest first.

sections.title: YouTube
descriptions: Selected videos focused on the stops, arrests, Airbnb operation, and police response. Firsthand footage and participant accounts come first, followed by the department’s explanation, attorney analysis, and shorter reporting.
Each entry includes its channel, runtime, publication date, and a brief description. Legal opinions and allegations in the videos are attributed commentary, not court findings.

contents.text_value: Original police recordings, organized by incident and officer, for checking the excerpts below. This link opens Internet Archive; the participant videos below are edited accounts.
Reckless Ben · 41:37 · May 30, 2026. Ben’s edited account of the vehicle stops, arrests, Airbnb operation, and questioning, with footage from the encounters.
Reckless Ben · 17:12 · June 1, 2026. Ben responds to Chief Paul’s statement and compares the department’s explanations with body-camera and dashcam footage.
Reckless Ben · 16:30 · June 4, 2026. Ben reviews newly available unredacted recordings and compares them with the earlier release. This is an edited selection with his commentary.
Tylers Production · 12:27 · May 31, 2026. Tyler Shaw gives his account of the stops, drug accusations, and detention, using encounter footage and an interview.
American Fork Police Department · 26:33 · May 30, 2026. Chief Cameron Paul presents the department’s explanation of the March 8–11 encounters and its reasons for the stops, arrests, and warrant.

contents.label: The Civil Rights Lawyer — five-part series

contents.text_value: The Civil Rights Lawyer · 57:02 · June 2, 2026. John Bryan interviews Ben about the dispute and his encounters with American Fork police.
The Civil Rights Lawyer · 1:08:46 · June 7, 2026. Interview with Tyler Shaw and analysis of the March 8 stop, trespass notices, and unredacted recordings.
The Civil Rights Lawyer · 1:38:01 · June 23, 2026. Detailed review of the March 9 stop, sobriety tests, muted audio, police-dog sniff, and vehicle search.
The Civil Rights Lawyer · 1:44:59 · July 1, 2026. Review of the March 10 investigation and arrest, including the conversations with Johnson and BAM’s CEO and verification of the civil papers.

The Civil Rights Lawyer · 2:25:17 · July 15, 2026. Continuation of the police-encounter review, a follow-up interview with Ben, and an interview with civil-rights attorney Solomon Radner. Updates reflect July 2026.

Clearly Established · 41:54 · June 3, 2026. Brandon Grable compares the search warrant, probable-cause statement, and footage, and discusses the omitted civil-case verification and qualified immunity.
Clearly Established · 29:34 · June 5, 2026. Grable examines the Airbnb operation, handcuffing, transport to AFPD, and the grounds for detaining each occupant.

Clearly Established · 43:31 · June 15, 2026. Grable reviews released training records and discusses possible city liability. His legal conclusions are commentary; the released records may not represent every training an officer received.
LegalEagle · 59:01 · June 9, 2026. Legal commentary comparing the released body-camera footage with the explanations for the police actions and discussing potential rights violations.
America's Attorney · 17:17 · June 9, 2026. Josh Sanford compares the police reports, body-camera footage, and Ben’s account. A shorter introduction to the competing explanations.
ABC4 Utah · 3:52 · June 2, 2026. Local news report introducing the arrests and misconduct allegations, with encounter footage and the department’s response. Reports the situation as of June 2026.

America's Attorney · 0:31 · July 9, 2026. Brief legal commentary on whether Ben could bring a police-retaliation claim. Useful as an introduction, with fuller context in the longer videos and records.
America's Attorney · 0:42 · June 11, 2026. Very short introduction to the broader dispute. Background context rather than a detailed review of police conduct.
